_description: Authoritative GBT (magnetic_representation='gbt_single_q') feature matrix produced by the WP6 integration task. This file is the single source of truth reconciling WP6a (HOH/overlap), WP6b (CCOR) and WP6c (Hubbard/constraints/velocity/torque/SOC). tests/unit/test_gbt_wp6_matrix.py fails if any row drifts from the source: every 'fatal' row's guard message must be present in the cited file, and every 'supported' row's oracle files must exist.

status: supported: enabled under GBT; requires oracle + bond-reversal + k-space Hermiticity evidence
fatal: rejected before Hamiltonian construction or before eigensolution
inactive: term exists in the codebase but contributes nothing in any representation mode
not_implemented: term does not exist in this codebase at all

rows.frame: collinear rotating frame; the endpoint link G_ab = (U_a0)^H Rz(q.d) U_b0 is applied to the primitive orbital S block before the LMTO contraction, exactly once
rows.bond_hermiticity: reverse directed bond h_ji(-d) = h_ij^H (test_gbt_oracles.py, test_gbt_structure.f90, test_gbt_wp6_matrix.py)
rows.kspace_hermiticity: pre-eigensolver max|H-H^H| assertion in reciprocal_fourier.f90; measured <= 2.3e-16 in wp6_hoh_k4

rows.term: Onsite potential factors (enim, obarm, wx0/wx1 endpoint W_i)
rows.frame: collinear rotating frame; no translational phase. At the d=0 bond slot the endpoint link is the identity by construction (G_ii = U^H Rz(0) U = I).
rows.bond_hermiticity: d=0 slot is Hermitian by construction; identity-link check onsite_fold_oracle
rows.kspace_hermiticity: k-independent additive block; covered by the full-H k-space check
rows.runtime_assertion: max_q0_common_link_error diagnostic in build_gbt_bulkham re-asserts G_ii = I every run

rows.term: HOH second-order operator (eeo = ee*obarm, h-o-h contraction)

rows.kspace_hermiticity: reciprocal second-order H Hermiticity 9.610e-17 (test_gbt_wp6_hoh.py); production max|H-H^H| <= 2.2888e-16 (wp6_hoh_k4)

rows.positive_definiteness: minimum eigenvalue exactly 1.0; zpotrf runs on every supported metric before zhegv
rows.bond_hermiticity: the metric is the identity at the d=0 slot and zero on every bond, so the reverse-bond identity holds trivially
rows.kspace_hermiticity: O(k)=I is Hermitian and positive definite at every k; the O(k) Hermiticity assertion in reciprocal_bands.f90 runs on it unconditionally

rows.frame: the same endpoint link G_ij is applied independently to primitive S and Sdot; D/Ddot and the completed CCOR block are composites and are never phased afterward
same link as ccor_scalar; endpoint Lambda_i/Lambda_j are onsite diagonal matrices in the same rotating frame

rows.term: Combined GBT + CCOR + HOH operator (ee+eecc fed into the h-o-h chain)
rows.frame: additive and multiplicative closure of the common endpoint link: any sum or chain of blocks carrying the same G_ab is itself covariant
rows.kspace_hermiticity: combined-operator k-space Hermiticity in composition_oracle; production max|H-H^H| <= 4.4431e-16 (wp6b_ccor_pair_surface_k4 runs with hoh=.true.)
rows.notes: WP6a and WP6b each audited their own slice; this row is the integration-owned cell that certifies their composition.

rows.frame: collinear rotating frame, spin-diagonal blocks from potential%ldm; folded into ee(:,:,1,ntype) at the d=0 slot after the primitive-link contraction, where the link is the identity

rows.kspace_hermiticity: onsite_fold_oracle: H(k) with the fold stays Hermitian and the fold is k- and q-independent
rows.notes: WP6c asserted this by the G_ii=I argument but produced no oracle and no production probe; the integration task supplies both.

rows.notes: Input boundary, not a GBT feature: q_ss is live under gbt_single_q (bond gauge) and explicit_texture (site moments) but dead under the default periodic_nc, where it used to be silently ignored and return a flat dispersion. Two legitimate interpretations exist, so the guard names all three exits rather than guessing one. Keyed on q_ss alone: a cone angle at q=0 is a global spin rotation and is energy-invariant without SOC, and frozen_magnon decks carry theta_ss through their initial periodic_nc build. Placed at build_bulkham, the production rebuild boundary, so it sees the representation AFTER calculation.f90 selects gbt_single_q for a frozen-magnon sweep.
